shots.description: Wide: sunny bedroom, Pip wakes up and stretches. Camera slowly pushes in.

dialogue.text: Good morning, sunshine! Pip is awake, and the day is brand new.

shots.description: Medium: Pip hops to the bathroom, grabs a small toothbrush. Sparkly toothpaste dot.

dialogue.text: Time to brush my teeth! Up, down, up, down.

shots.description: Close-up: Pip smiles into mirror, teeth sparkle (soft glow, no flashing).

dialogue.text: Brush for two whole minutes. Count with me. One, two, three!
